verdict.rationale: Increase models each customer as an Entity through the API and exposes Entity validations for each version of the data, so customer verification is at least partly programmatic. The evidence is thin, though: it never describes distinct KYC and KYB flows, document collection, watchlist screening, or a modeled application state machine. Missing for 10: explicit KYC (individual) vs KYB (business) flows, document upload/collection, watchlist/sanctions screening, clearly documented application/verification states, independent or hands-on corroboration.
